title: ToolsPanel re-theme: tool buttons have inconsistent up/active state styling + no hover state (regression from f27bb24)
description:
FIXED. Root cause = React shorthand/longhand border stranding (f27bb24 regression): styles.toolBtn up state used the `border` shorthand while toolBtnActive spread bevel("sunken") longhands; on active->up React rewrote the shorthand but never cleared the stale longhands, leaving a 2px outset black frame on every previously-selected tool. Plus no hover state.

FIX (packages/authoring-ui/src/ToolsPanel.tsx): added transparentBorder() helper emitting the SAME four longhand border props as bevel(); toolBtn/objectDrawingBtn up state and optBtnStyle() inactive branch now use it, so up/over/active differ only by border colours + bg (no shorthand/longhand mix). Added Halo roll-over: toolBtnHover/objectDrawingBtnHover styles (halo.rollOverColor #B2E1FF bg + bevel("raised")) and optBtnStyle(active,hover) raised branch, wired via local hovered state + onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave on every tool button, the OD toggle, and all option toggles (pencil/free-transform/lasso/wand/polystar). Active still = bevel("sunken") over insetFieldStrip.

VERIFY:
- pnpm --filter ./packages/** build => Done (all 7 packages).
- pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run => 44 files, 653 tests, ALL PASS (0 failures).
- Playwright firsthand repro (drive hover/click + computed-style introspection, served from worktree on :1421): (a) after click Line then Oval, deselected Line border == never-selected Pen border (rgba(0,0,0,0) 1px solid) with NO 2px/outset residue [was rgb(0,0,0) 2px outset before fix]; (b) exactly one sunken-active tool (Oval active border != flat-up, Selection stays flat-up); (c) hovering non-active Line changes bg/border. Spec PASSED. Screenshot captured (apps/desktop/test-results/toolspanel-1262-states.png) showing corrected states; temp spec/config removed after verification.
